einzeiler: The harrowing story of tank veteran Sam Bradshaw during Operation Crusader in 1941.
kurzfassung: The episode follows the wartime experiences of Second World War veteran Sam Bradshaw during Operation Crusader in November 1941. As a lance corporal in the 6th Royal Tank Regiment, Bradshaw finds himself in the chaotic and deadly North African desert fighting German forces. Severely wounded during a tank engagement, he endures a nightmarish evacuation through a series of field hospitals and lost ambulances.
stichpunkte: Introduction of Sam Bradshaw, an articulate and memorable Second World War veteran from Liverpool
Overview of the North African campaign leading up to Operation Crusader in November 1941
The 6th Royal Tank Regiment forms a nightly defensive circle known as a liga in the desert
German forces exploit lax British radio security and superior 88mm anti-tank guns to set a devastating trap
Bradshaw's tank is hit during a chaotic battle, resulting in heavy casualties across his squadron
Bradshaw is seriously wounded in the side while attempting to rescue fellow soldiers from a burning tank
He survives a close encounter with a German patrol that dismisses him as dead
An arduous and painful medical evacuation via lost ambulances and field stations across the desert
After reaching an underground hospital on the Egyptian coast, Bradshaw learns his wound is not severe enough to send him home permanently

clips.text: The hosts reflect on interviewing hundreds of veterans and note how this particular individual stands out as exceptionally articulate and unforgettable.

clips.hook: The devastating range of the German 88
clips.text: An explanation of the technical disparity between British two-pounder guns and German anti-aircraft artillery capable of firing thousands of feet into the air.
While sitting on his tank waiting for combat to begin, a soldier contemplates a spider and thinks about who will survive the coming day.

clips.hook: Mistaken for dead in the desert
clips.text: A wounded soldier lying on the ground is approached by an enemy combatant who looks down at him, declares him deceased to someone nearby, and walks away.
Wounded men suffer through excruciating pain and horrific injuries while trapped inside a crowded vehicle traveling through the barren desert.

beschreibung:
Why did young British men like Sam Bradshaw end up fighting overseas in North Africa? When was the situation in North Africa at the start of The Second World War? How did Allied forces do against Italians in North Africa during WW2?

Join Jim and Al for part 1 of a new series focussing on one man's war, as they follow the exploits of Sam Bradshaw in 6th Royal Tank Regiment in North Africa and Italy.
